name: The Villas of Holly Brook Chatham

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in mop water. Discussed with PIC, mop was relocated to strainer portion of bucket. Ensure mop is being stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.113 Storing Maintenance Tools. Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed small amounts of black mold to be present in ice machine. Discussed with PIC, ice machine will be properly cleaned. Ensure staff is cleaning food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation. Inspector has scheduled a follow up for 3/11/2026.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.

findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed the front cold holding cooler to be at 58F. Discussed with PIC, cooler was not turned on. Cooler was turned on and ran a temperature of 41F. Ensure any TCS food being cold held is kept at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.comment: Observed ice accumulation on the hose under the fan unit in the walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, ensure walk in freezer is serviced by a licensed individual. Ensure staff is regularly checking walk in freezer to ensure no ice accumulation is present.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

(REPEAT) Observed the majority of the cabinets in the kitchen needing replaced. Many have broken off doors and/or paint significantly coming away. Some of the shelving inside the cabinets need sealed (paint and or/ clear coat). The facility is supposed to have a kitchen renovation at some point.

Repairs are actively being made to the whole building, after discussing with Director, the kitchen will be done after the hallways have been painted. The cabinets will be replaced, a new stove will be installed, and the ceiling vents will be getting replaced.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

(REPEAT) Observed no active sanitization bucket at the start of the inspection. Discussed with CFPM’s. Both employees are CFPM’s. Employee made a new bucket. Ensure sani buckets are created before start of food service. Quat - 400 ppm. COS. Repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 12/18/23.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the standing mixer in the corner near the ice machine to have a layer of food splash on it. Discussed with employee. Employee began to wash, rinse, and sanitize. Ensure food-contact equipment is washed, rinsed, and sanitized after use to prevent food debris build-up. COS.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser. 

(REPEAT) Observed the plates and bowls throughout the resident eating area to be flipped upright. Cease practice. Ensure plates and bowls are turned upside down to prevent cross contamination. Discussed with PIC. Repeat violation since last routine inspection on 7/10/23. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation. 

(REPEAT) Observed a large tray under the steam machine in the kitchen to be full of water. The steam machine appears to be leaking and the tray is catching the water. The equipment should be repaired. The drip pan is only a temporary solution. Discussed with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection. Repeat violation since the 7/10/23 inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Upon start of inspection, no active sanitization bucket was present. Employee was actively engaging in food manipulation. Ensure sani buckets are made prior to cooking. Discussed with PIC. PIC made a sani bucket - 400 ppm quat. COS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

(REPEAT) Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be dirty:
1. Baffles of hood system are soiled with build-up of debris.
2. Interior of the fryer doors are soiled with grease build-up.
3. The pantry wall is soiled with food splash (the wall directly in front of you as you walk into the pantry).
4. The top of the dish machine has a layer of debris.
5. Area under the dish machine has a layer of food splash and debris on the coving, wall, and floor.
6. The floors under the shelving in the walk-in freezer have debris.

Discussed routine cleaning of non-food contact surfaces with PIC. Ensure areas are cleaned. #4-5 are repeat violations since the last routine inspection on 7/10/23. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Company came to service (Sealed Air Diversey Care). Testing at 10 ppm. Multiple runs conducted. Most test strips were 0 ppm.

Inspector will follow-up on 7/14/23.

PIC called company to come back during the follow-up. Utilize 3 compartment sink until repaired.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

Observed no certified food protection manager (CFPM) present during operational hours. Cook in kitchen is a food handler with a valid license. Cook was making food during the inspection. The facility is in need of at least 2 CFPM’s to cover all hours. Only CFPM works mornings to after lunch. The dinner shifts and weekends must be covered by a CFPM as well. Ensure one of the other staff members completes the course and receives the license. Two more CFPM’s would be ideal totaling 3 for the facility. Discussed with PIC. Facility has had turnover since the last routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed the dish machine to be dispensing 0 ppm of chlorine bleach. Inspector ran the dish machine several times and checked with test strips. Facility has test strips above the dish machine to check concentration levels. Ensure dish machine is dispensing bleach. Utilize the 3 compartment sink with sanitizer until dish machine is operating correctly again. Inspector will follow-up on 7/12/23.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the following food-contact surfaces to be in need of cleaning (wash, rinse, sanitize):
1. The interior baffle of the ice machine has a layer of black/pink mold on the lip. Inspector pointed this out to the cook. Ensure the machine has ice removed and the inside is washed, rinsed, sanitized. Ensure staff is aware of checking ice machine for mold accumulation.
2. The steam table outside the kitchen (for the residents to use as a buffet) has very dirty water in every basin and a layer of scum. Every basin within the steam table needs washed, rinsed, sanitized and the steam water replaced.
3. Interior and exterior door of the kitchen microwave is soiled - layer of food splash/debris. Ensure the microwave is cleaned nightly - wash, rinse, sanitize.

Discussed routine cleaning of food-contact surfaces with PIC. Ensure areas are cleaned by he 7/20/23 follow-up date.

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the following non-food contact surfaces in need of cleaning:
1. The top of the dish machine has a layer of debris.
2. Area under the dish machine has a layer of food splash and debris on the coving, wall, and floor. 

Discussed routine cleaning with PIC. Ensure areas are cleaned - washed, rinsed, sanitize. Clean by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

Observed multiple areas in need of repairs within the kitchen:
1. Main hand sink in the kitchen needs re-caulked to the wall, as well as the secondary hand sink by the dish machine. Both are beginning to come away from the sink and wall and need re-caulked.
2. Dish machine equipment is coming away from the wall and needs re-caulked: equipment is coming away from the wall and machinery. The area in front of the spay nozzle has black mold/caulking on the wall and needs re-caulked.
3. Majority of the cabinets in the kitchen needs replaced. Many have broken off doors and/or paint significantly coming away from drawers/cabinets. Some of the shelving inside the cabinets need sealed (with paint and/or clear coat; not smooth and easily cleanable, nonabsorbent). Per the last several inspections, the facility kitchen was to have a major overhaul/remodel completed along with all new cabinets. This has yet to occur and no set date for construction could be given. The cabinets and drawers need to be repaired/replaced by the next routine inspection.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets in the facility are observed at 0 ppm Quat sanitizer. Buckets were remade during the inspection to correct the violation. The jug of concentrate that the equipment was pulling from appears to be extremely low and the PIC is not sure that another jug is in the back to replace it. Inspector will spot check on 10/3/22 to ensure that sanitizers are still available.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

1) Shelves in the walk in cooler have small accumulations of mold growth; 2) the wall next to the dish machine has an accumulation of black growth. PIC instructed to clean both locations and maintain clean moving foreword.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

The inner roof of the microwave next to the ice machine is observed heavily soiled with grease/food splash. PIC instructed to maintain clean when not in use. PIC cleaned the microwave during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

Pink bacterial slime/mold is observed along the junction where the supports for the top section of the salad bar meet the metal rim around the ice bath section of the salad bar. Given the amount of moisture involved in this area it should be maintained clean. PIC was directed to this situation and it was cleaned/ sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-307.11: FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306. 

The fire sprinkler in the walk in cooler has a slow but consistent drip and is located straight inside the door. Inspector believes that this posses a potential source of contamination as foods are brought into and out of the walk in cooler as well as the walk in freezer. PIC is instructed to have the location serviced by a qualified technician in order to remedy the situation.
